title: Read receipts
summary: Shows who read what. In a DM, ticks on the person's own messages: sent and read (ADR 0141). In a group, small avatars of readers under the newest message they read, and a sheet with the names. The app also sends the person's own receipts.

state.description: sending and failed from the local send state. sent: the server has it. read: in a DM, the other person's read receipt is on this message or a later one.

status.description: DM: the status of each own message. Shown only on the newest own message and on failed ones.

readers.description: Group: readers whose latest receipt is on this message, from EventTimelineItem readReceipts. Up to 3 avatars, then +N.

sheetOpen.description: Group: the seen-by sheet is open.

markRead.effect: When the newest message is on screen and the app is in the foreground: Timeline.markAsRead with ReceiptType Read (public receipts, ADR 0050).

openReaders.effect: Group only: opens the sheet with each reader and the time.

notes: No delivered tick: Matrix has no delivered signal (ADR 0141).
Receipts are always public; there is no private receipt option (ADR 0050).
bipe_app_receipt_sent and bipe_app_receipt_read are the accessibility labels of the ticks. The ticks are icons, not text.
The seen-by sheet is not shown in a DM.
